# Nimbus

> Kotlin Multiplatform (Android · JVM · iOS) download manager library.
> Targets: Android minSdk 21, JVM 17, iOS.
> All errors are returned as typed values — no exceptions thrown across the public API.
> Optional content digest: hash the bytes in the pass that already writes them to disk.

## Coordinates

```
# Core library
io.github.giovanniandreuzza:nimbus:<version>

# Optional Ktor HTTP adapter (recommended — saves you implementing NimbusDownloadPort)
io.github.giovanniandreuzza:nimbus-ktor:<version>
```

## Initialisation (do once, store the result in your DI container)

```kotlin
// build() + init() — both are plain (non-suspending) functions.
// init() starts loading persisted tasks in the background and returns NimbusAPI immediately.
// The first actual API call suspends briefly if loading is still in progress;
// all subsequent calls proceed without delay once loading has completed.
val api: NimbusAPI = Nimbus.Builder()
    .withNimbusDownloadPort(ktorAdapter)      // required — your HTTP client adapter
    .withDownloadManagerPath(storePath)       // required — path for the metadata store
    .withConcurrencyLimit(2)                  // optional, default 1
    .withDownloadBufferSize(8 * 1024L)        // optional, default 8 KB
    .withDownloadNotifyEveryBytes(512 * 1024L)// optional, default ~512 KB
    .withMaxRetryAttempts(3)                  // optional, default 3
    .withRetryBaseDelayMs(500L)               // optional, default 500 ms
    .withMinReservedDiskBytes(50 * 1024 * 1024L) // optional — disk headroom guard
    .withAutoStart(true)                      // optional, default false
    .withContentDigest(DigestAlgorithm.SHA256)// optional, default null (no hashing at all)
    .withNimbusLogger(myLogger)               // optional
    .build()
    .init()

// One-liner convenience (equivalent):
val api: NimbusAPI = Nimbus.Builder()….createAndInit()
```

If loading fails (e.g. corrupt store), `NimbusError.PermanentError(PermanentNimbusErrorCause.InitializationFailed(...))` is returned by the
first API call rather than at `init()` time.

## NimbusAPI — complete method reference

All methods are `suspend` unless noted. All return `KResult<T, NimbusError>` except
`isDownloaded` (returns `Boolean`) and `observeAllDownloads` (non-suspend, returns a `Flow`).

```kotlin
// Query
suspend fun isDownloaded(fileUrl: String): Boolean
suspend fun getFileSize(fileUrl: String): KResult<Long, NimbusError>
suspend fun getDownloadTask(fileUrl: String): KResult<DownloadTaskDTO, NimbusError>
suspend fun getAllDownloads(): KResult<List<DownloadTaskDTO>, NimbusError>
fun observeAllDownloads(): Flow<List<DownloadTaskDTO>>   // NOT suspend — cold Flow, never completes
// Emits the whole catalogue on every change, including progress ticks. This is the hook for a
// supervisor loop that watches for DownloadState.Failed and schedules its own retry.
suspend fun checksum(fileUrl: String): KResult<Checksum, NimbusError>
// Re-derives the digest of a finished file by reading it back off disk. Requires
// withContentDigest(...) to be configured and the task to be Finished. Not cached —
// every call reads the whole file.

// Lifecycle
suspend fun enqueueDownload(fileUrl: String, filePath: String, fileName: String, expectedChecksum: Checksum? = null): KResult<DownloadTaskDTO, NimbusError>
suspend fun startDownload(fileUrl: String): KResult<Unit, NimbusError>
suspend fun observeDownload(fileUrl: String): KResult<Flow<DownloadState>, NimbusError>
suspend fun pauseDownload(fileUrl: String): KResult<Unit, NimbusError>
suspend fun resumeDownload(fileUrl: String): KResult<Unit, NimbusError>
suspend fun cancelDownload(fileUrl: String): KResult<Unit, NimbusError>  // also deletes partial file

// Cleanup
suspend fun removeDownload(fileUrl: String, deleteAssociatedFile: Boolean = false): KResult<Unit, NimbusError>
// removeDownload only succeeds when state is Finished or Failed; use cancelDownload for active tasks.

// Auto-start (when withAutoStart(true) is set on the Builder)
// enqueueDownload automatically fires startDownload in the background — no manual call needed.
// Any failure from the background start is emitted as NimbusLogEvent.AutoStartFailed and the
// task stays Enqueued so it can be started manually. Internal transient-error retry
// (maxRetryAttempts / retryBaseDelayMs) still applies once the download is running.

// Recovery
suspend fun retryFailedDownload(fileUrl: String): KResult<Unit, NimbusError>
// Refetches remote size, deletes partial file, resets state to Enqueued. Call startDownload after.

// High-level convenience
suspend fun ensureDownloaded(fileUrl: String, filePath: String, fileName: String, expectedChecksum: Checksum? = null): KResult<Flow<DownloadState>, NimbusError>
// Handles the full lifecycle automatically:
//   already finished  → returns flowOf(DownloadState.Finished)
//   stale finished    → clears metadata, re-downloads
//   failed            → calls retryFailedDownload, then starts
//   paused/enqueued   → resumes or starts, returns observeDownload flow
//   not found         → enqueues, starts, returns observeDownload flow
```

## DownloadState sealed class

```kotlin
sealed class DownloadState {
    data object Enqueued : DownloadState()
    data class  Downloading(val progress: Double) : DownloadState()  // 0.0–100.0
    data class  Paused(val progress: Double) : DownloadState()       // 0.0–100.0
    data class  Failed(val error: DownloadError) : DownloadState()   // typed DownloadError
    data object Finished : DownloadState()
    data object Cancelled : DownloadState()
}
```

`observeDownload` returns a `Flow<DownloadState>` that **auto-completes** when the state
reaches `Finished` or `Failed`. No manual cancellation needed.

## DownloadTaskDTO fields

```kotlin
data class DownloadTaskDTO(
    val id: String,        // SHA-256 of fileUrl — stable across sessions
    val fileName: String,
    val fileUrl: String,
    val filePath: String,
    val fileSize: Long,    // bytes
    val state: DownloadState,
    val expectedChecksum: Checksum? = null,  // what the caller asked for, if anything
    val checksum: Checksum? = null           // what the bytes hashed to, once Finished
)
```

## Content digest (optional — 2.3.0)

Off by default. With no algorithm configured nothing is hashed and the transfer path is the one
2.2.0 shipped. Enable it on the Builder:

```kotlin
Nimbus.Builder().withContentDigest(DigestAlgorithm.SHA256)
```

```kotlin
data class Checksum(val algorithm: DigestAlgorithm, val value: String) {
    companion object {
        // Validates length and hex alphabet, lowercases the value. Throws IllegalArgumentException
        // on a malformed digest — this is construction, not a download, so it is not a KResult.
        fun of(algorithm: DigestAlgorithm, value: String): Checksum
    }
}

enum class DigestAlgorithm { SHA256 }   // 64 hex characters
```

Three things it gives you, all the same capability:

```kotlin
// 1. Verify a transfer against a digest your backend published.
api.enqueueDownload(url, path, name, expectedChecksum = Checksum.of(DigestAlgorithm.SHA256, sha))
api.ensureDownloaded(url, path, name, expectedChecksum = Checksum.of(DigestAlgorithm.SHA256, sha))
// A mismatch is TemporaryDownloadErrorCause.ChecksumMismatch and is RETRIED — it describes the
// transfer (a corrupted proxy response, a stale cache), not the file at the origin.

// 2. Learn what you downloaded — DownloadTaskDTO.checksum is populated once Finished.
val what = api.getDownloadTask(url).getOr { return }.checksum

// 3. Re-verify a file later, without reading and hashing it yourself.
when (val r = api.checksum(url)) { … }
```

Point 3 is what separates a file whose bytes changed since download from a file that is intact
and simply cannot be used. A consumer that treats the second as the first deletes and
re-downloads a good file on every failure, forever.

`checksum(fileUrl)` fails with:
- `PermanentNimbusErrorCause.UnexpectedError` (code `content_digest_disabled`) — no algorithm configured
- `PermanentNimbusErrorCause.DownloadNotFound` — no task for this URL
- `PermanentNimbusErrorCause.InvalidState(state)` — the task is not `Finished`

**Resume correctness.** The resume offset comes from the length of the partial file on disk, so a
digest accumulated only across one streaming session would hash the tail alone after a process
restart and produce a value that is well-formed, plausible and wrong. The digest is therefore
primed from the bytes already on disk at the start of *every* streaming attempt, with no
conditional: a fresh download reads nothing, a resume re-reads its prefix, and retries and 416
truncations are covered by the same rule. A download that ran straight through and one that was
interrupted and resumed produce the same digest.

**Cost.** Every byte already passes through the write path exactly once, so hashing adds the hash
and no extra pass. `checksum(fileUrl)` is the exception: it reads the whole file back.

## NimbusError sealed class — exhaustive list

`NimbusError` has only two top-level variants. All error detail is carried in a typed cause sealed class,
enabling exhaustive `when` matching at every level.

```kotlin
sealed class NimbusError {
    // Transient — the operation may be retried
    data class TemporaryError(val errorCause: TemporaryNimbusErrorCause) : NimbusError()
    // Non-recoverable — retrying will not help
    data class PermanentError(val errorCause: PermanentNimbusErrorCause) : NimbusError()
}

// ── TemporaryNimbusErrorCause ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
sealed class TemporaryNimbusErrorCause {
    data class DownloadFailed(val errorCause: TemporaryDownloadErrorCause) : TemporaryNimbusErrorCause()
    data class GetFileSizeFailed(val errorCause: TemporaryGetFileSizeErrorCause) : TemporaryNimbusErrorCause()
}

// ── PermanentNimbusErrorCause ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
sealed class PermanentNimbusErrorCause {
    // Input validation (before any network call)
    data object InvalidPath        // filePath contains ".." traversal component
    data object InvalidUrl         // fileUrl is not http/https
    data object InvalidFileName    // fileName is blank, ".", "..", or contains / \ \0
    data class  InvalidFileSize(cause: KError? = null)  // remote reported size <= 0
    data object DownloadNotFound   // no task registered for this fileUrl
    data class  FilePathInUse(filePath: String)
    data class  InsufficientDiskSpace(path: String, requiredBytes: Long, availableBytes: Long)

    // State machine violations
    data class  InvalidState(currentState: DownloadState)  // operation not allowed in this state

    // Initialisation
    data class  InitializationFailed(cause: KError)

    // Network / download
    data object ResourceNotFound   // HTTP 404
    data class  DownloadFailed(errorCause: PermanentDownloadErrorCause)
    data class  GetFileSizeFailed(errorCause: PermanentGetFileSizeErrorCause)

    // Storage
    data class  StorageError(cause: KError)
    data class  UnexpectedError(cause: KError? = null)
}
```

### DownloadError cause types (reachable via `DownloadState.Failed` and `NimbusError` cause chains)

```kotlin
// Carried by DownloadState.Failed and TemporaryNimbusErrorCause.DownloadFailed /
// PermanentNimbusErrorCause.DownloadFailed
sealed class DownloadError {
    data class TemporaryError(val errorCause: TemporaryDownloadErrorCause) : DownloadError()
    data class PermanentError(val errorCause: PermanentDownloadErrorCause) : DownloadError()
}

sealed class TemporaryDownloadErrorCause {
    data class  ServerError(statusCode: Int)   // HTTP 5xx
    data object RangeNotSatisfiable            // HTTP 416; adapter truncates and retries from byte 0
    data object FileIntegrityMismatch          // downloaded size ≠ expected size; will retry
    data object FileNotAccessible              // local file could not be opened for writing; will retry
    data object TruncateRace                   // could not recreate file after 416 truncation; will retry
    data object ChecksumMismatch               // transferred bytes ≠ expectedChecksum; will retry
    data class  TransportFailure(cause: KError) // timeout, reset, DNS, TLS; will retry
}

sealed class PermanentDownloadErrorCause {
    data object ResourceNotFound                           // HTTP 404
    data class  ClientError(statusCode: Int)               // HTTP 4xx (excluding 404)
    data class  InconsistentRangeResponse(reason: String)  // server returned 200 when 206 expected on resume
    data object LocalFileOversized                         // local file > expected download size
    data class  StorageError(cause: KError)                // I/O or permission failure
    data class  UnexpectedError(cause: KError? = null)
}

// Carried by TemporaryNimbusErrorCause.GetFileSizeFailed /
// PermanentNimbusErrorCause.GetFileSizeFailed
sealed class GetFileSizeError {
    data class TemporaryError(val errorCause: TemporaryGetFileSizeErrorCause) : GetFileSizeError()
    data class PermanentError(val errorCause: PermanentGetFileSizeErrorCause) : GetFileSizeError()
}

sealed class TemporaryGetFileSizeErrorCause {
    data class ServerError(statusCode: Int)     // HTTP 5xx
    data class TransportFailure(cause: KError)  // timeout, reset, DNS, TLS; will retry
}

sealed class PermanentGetFileSizeErrorCause {
    data object ResourceNotFound              // HTTP 404
    data class  ClientError(statusCode: Int)  // HTTP 4xx (excluding 404)
    data object FileSizeUnavailable           // no Content-Length in HEAD or Range probe
    data class  UnexpectedError(cause: KError? = null)
}
```

## KResult usage patterns

```kotlin
// Unwrap or return early
val task = api.enqueueDownload(url, path, name).getOr { error ->
    // error: NimbusError
    return
}

// Side-effect on failure only
api.startDownload(url).onFailure { error -> log(error) }

// Exhaustive fold
api.getDownloadTask(url).fold(
    onSuccess = { dto -> show(dto) },
    onFailure = { error ->
        when (error) {
            is NimbusError.PermanentError -> when (error.errorCause) {
                PermanentNimbusErrorCause.DownloadNotFound -> showEmpty()
                else -> showError(error)
            }
            is NimbusError.TemporaryError -> showRetry()
        }
    }
)
```

## Common patterns

### Simple download (manual steps)

```kotlin
// All these calls must happen inside a coroutine.
api.enqueueDownload(url, filePath, fileName).getOr { return@launch }
api.startDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }
api.observeDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }.collect { state ->
    when (state) {
        DownloadState.Enqueued         -> { /* waiting */ }
        is DownloadState.Downloading   -> updateProgress(state.progress)
        is DownloadState.Paused        -> showPaused(state.progress)
        is DownloadState.Failed        -> showError(state.error)
        DownloadState.Finished         -> showDone()
    }
}
```

### One-liner convenience (recommended)

```kotlin
api.ensureDownloaded(url, filePath, fileName).getOr { return@launch }.collect { state ->
    when (state) { … }
}
```

### Pause and resume

```kotlin
api.pauseDownload(url).onFailure { log(it) }
// Later:
api.resumeDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }
api.observeDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }.collect { … }
```

### Retry after failure

```kotlin
api.retryFailedDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }
api.startDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }
api.observeDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }.collect { … }
```

### Verified download, and re-verification later

```kotlin
val expected = Checksum.of(DigestAlgorithm.SHA256, shaFromYourBackend)

// Verified on the way in — a mismatch is temporary and retried automatically.
api.ensureDownloaded(url, filePath, fileName, expectedChecksum = expected)
    .getOr { return@launch }
    .collect { state -> when (state) { … } }

// Re-verified later, e.g. when the file fails to play and you need to know why.
when (val r = api.checksum(url)) {
    is Success -> if (r.value == expected) {
        // bytes are intact — the problem is elsewhere; do NOT re-download
    } else {
        api.removeDownload(url, deleteAssociatedFile = true)  // bytes changed on disk
    }
    is Failure -> log(r.error)
}
```

### Cleanup after finish

```kotlin
// Remove metadata only (keep file on disk):
api.removeDownload(url)
// Remove metadata AND delete file:
api.removeDownload(url, deleteAssociatedFile = true)
```

## State machine — valid transitions

```
Enqueued  ──startDownload──►  Downloading  ──pauseDownload──►  Paused
                                    │                              │
                                    │                         resumeDownload
                                    ▼                              │
                                Finished ◄─────────────────────────┘
                                    │
                                 (error)
                                    ▼
                                 Failed  ──retryFailedDownload──► Enqueued
```

`cancelDownload` is valid from any state and removes both metadata and the partial file.
`removeDownload` is only valid from `Finished` or `Failed`.

## What Nimbus does NOT do

- Does not validate that `filePath`'s parent directory exists — create it before calling `enqueueDownload`.
- Does not enforce a process-wide singleton — use your DI container's `single {}` for that.
- Does not support non-HTTP(S) URLs.
- Does not resume downloads that were `Enqueued` but never started across sessions —
  call `startDownload` again after `init()` if you want auto-resume on restart.

## Implementing NimbusDownloadPort (required if not using nimbus-ktor)

```kotlin
interface NimbusDownloadPort {
    suspend fun getFileSize(fileUrl: String): KResult<Long, GetFileSizeError>
    suspend fun downloadFile(
        fileUrl: String,
        offset: Long,
        onSourceOpened: suspend (Source) -> Unit
    ): KResult<Unit, DownloadError>
}
```

The `onSourceOpened` lambda receives a `kotlinx.io.Source`. Stream it to the sink Nimbus
provides internally — do not buffer the entire response in memory.

**HTTP resume contract** (what your implementation must handle):
- When `offset > 0`, send `Range: bytes=offset-`.
- Accept **206** with matching `Content-Range` start byte.
- Reject **200** with a non-empty body when offset > 0 — this would corrupt the file
  (`DownloadError.PermanentError(PermanentDownloadErrorCause.InconsistentRangeResponse(reason))`).
- Map **416** → `DownloadError.TemporaryError(TemporaryDownloadErrorCause.RangeNotSatisfiable)`.

## Using KtorDownloadAdapter (nimbus-ktor artifact)

```kotlin
// Add dependency: io.github.giovanniandreuzza:nimbus-ktor:<version>
import io.github.giovanniandreuzza.nimbus.ktor.KtorDownloadAdapter

val adapter = KtorDownloadAdapter(httpClient)   // caller owns HttpClient lifecycle

val api = Nimbus.Builder()
    .withNimbusDownloadPort(adapter)
    .withDownloadManagerPath(storePath)
    .build()
    .init()
    .getOr { … }
```

`KtorDownloadAdapter` handles:
- `HEAD` for size; falls back to `GET Range: bytes=0-0` + `Content-Range` when `Content-Length` is absent.
- 206 / 200 / 416 mapping to the typed `DownloadError` hierarchy.
- `InconsistentRangeResponse` guard for servers that return a full 200 body on a resume request.

## Android — withAndroidContext extension

On Android, you can call `.withAndroidContext(context)` on the Builder to have the storage
adapter automatically resolve paths relative to the app's files directory.

## Optional: NimbusLogger

```kotlin
fun interface NimbusLogger {
    suspend fun log(event: NimbusLogEvent)
}
```

`NimbusLogEvent` variants:

```kotlin
sealed class NimbusLogEvent {
    data class DownloadEnqueued(val fileUrl: String, val filePath: String, val expectedSizeBytes: Long)
    data class DownloadStartRequested(val fileUrl: String)
    data class DownloadFinished(val fileUrl: String)
    data class DownloadFailed(val fileUrl: String, val error: NimbusError)
    data class EnsureDownloadedAlreadyComplete(val fileUrl: String)
    data class EnsureDownloadedStaleFinishedRemoved(val fileUrl: String)
    data class InsufficientDiskSpace(val fileUrl: String?, val path: String, val requiredBytes: Long, val availableBytes: Long)
    data class AutoStartFailed(val fileUrl: String, val error: NimbusError)
}
```

Implementations should be fast and non-throwing; dispatch to a background dispatcher if needed.
